description: This file contains the implementation of the Sizzle CSS Selector Engine v1.10.17-pre, a JavaScript library for CSS selector parsing and DOM element matching.

methods.name: createCache
methods.description: Creates a cache function for storing key-value pairs with limited size.

methods.name: markFunction
methods.description: Marks a function with a special property for internal use.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Tests support for certain DOM features by executing a function with a test element.

methods.name: addHandle
methods.description: Adds attribute handlers for specific attribute names.

methods.name: siblingCheck
methods.description: Compares the document order of two sibling elements.

methods.name: createInputPseudo
methods.description: Creates a pseudo-class function for input types.

methods.name: createButtonPseudo
methods.description: Creates a pseudo-class function for button types.

methods.name: createPositionalPseudo
methods.description: Creates a pseudo-class function for positional selectors.

methods.name: testContext
methods.description: Validates if a node can be used as a context for selector matching.

methods.name: setDocument
methods.description: Initializes document-related variables based on the current document context.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes a CSS selector string into an array of tokens.

methods.name: toSelector
methods.description: Converts an array of tokens back into a selector string.

methods.name: addCombinator
methods.description: Wraps a matcher function with a combinator (e.g., child, sibling).

methods.name: elementMatcher
methods.description: Combines multiple matcher functions into one that tests all.

methods.name: condense
methods.description: Filters and condenses an array of unmatched elements based on a filter function.

methods.name: setMatcher
methods.description: Creates a complex matcher with pre- and post-filters.

methods.name: matcherFromTokens
methods.description: Builds a matcher function from a list of tokens.

methods.name: matcherFromGroupMatchers
methods.description: Creates a matcher from element and set matchers.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a selector into a reusable matcher function.

methods.name: multipleContexts
methods.description: Executes a selector across multiple contexts.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Executes a compiled selector on a context and populates results.
